thread:
morgan: Support triaged a new user who followed the quickstart but their first SDK call returned 402 and the client gave zero guidance. They were stuck.

alejandra: Can you paste the proxied response? 402 generally means billing not complete or trial limit.

morgan: Gateway payload: ```json
{"status":402, "code":"billing_required", "request_id":"req_qs_2165", "workspace_id":"ws_test_77"}
```

phil: Two likely causes we've seen: (1) workspace actually needs billing setup, (2) local dev proxies (vercel/netlify/ngrok) are dropping `x-workspace-id` so requests land on a different workspace and trigger billing.

morgan: Repro steps I ran: clone `redwood-quickstart`, set `REDWOOD_KEY` to the reported key, `vercel dev`, open incognito, click demo -> 402. When I ran the dev server without the vercel proxy the call succeeded.

alejandra: SDK UX fix: treat HTTP 402 as an onboarding error (OnboardingBillingError), mark non-retriable, and include `help_url`: `https://app.redwood.ai/orgs/<org>/billing`. Also include an `admin_hint` string telling end-users to ask their org admin to complete billing.

phil: Sample fix: detect missing `x-workspace-id` and print a loud dev-mode warning in server logs/console with specific remediation: "If using Vercel/Netlify dev CLI, enable header forwarding or run the server directly. Missing workspace header can cause requests to hit the wrong workspace and trigger billing gates." Add the same note to quickstart README.

morgan: Action items: 
- SDK: map 402 -> OnboardingBillingError, non-retriable, attach help_url (phil to PR, 48h).
- Samples/docs: add dev-proxy caveat and header-warning (alejandra to patch README and sample server, 24h).
- Support: DM the affected user with docs link and keep ticket open until SDK change lands (support).

onboard-bot: Suggested auto-DM: "It looks like your organization needs to complete billing setup to use API access. See https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/billing for next steps." :wave:

phil: Also add a Sentry grouping key `onboard.billing_required` and include `request_id` and `workspace_id` as breadcrumbs (no secrets). We'll also standardize behavior across JS/Python/Go SDKs in a cross-SDK issue.

morgan: Thanks team — small changes but should reduce a lot of first-call confusion. :thumbsup:
